name: pure-admin-visual
description: Lightweight data-focused admin framework with native grid system

scripts.build-js: echo JavaScript files served directly from src/js/
scripts.build-all: npm run build-css && npm run build-themes && npm run build-js
scripts.watch-js: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='src/js';let t=0;setInterval(()=>{const n=fs.statSync(p).mtimeMs;if(n>t&&t>0){console.log('Changes detected, rebuilding...');require('child_process').execSync('npm run build-js',{stdio:'inherit'})}t=n},1000)"
scripts.watch-all: concurrently "npm run watch-css" "npm run watch-themes" "npm run watch-js"
